items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: He and I slept together in a room on the second floor... I told him that I would meet him on the road one day and straighten the matter out.

ctx.x: cow. I just could not get the technique of how it was done.

Tom Sparks was younger than I and smaller in size because his mother and father were small people. But Tom was very smart and studious. He must have inherited something in that sense from John Coleman who was his uncle also. None of the children were going to school except Tom as children living in the country were not obliged to attend school in those days. Tom had to walk 7 miles to school and 7 back home. He and I slept together in a room on the second floor which was like walking into a refrigerator in the…

On a farm across from where we lived were two white boys and they had a pony and buggy. They drove to and from their school which was on the same road that Tom had to take, and when I first came there, Tom told me that these two boys would beat him up at times when they caught him coming home. I told him that I would meet him on the road one day and straighten the matter out. Eventually these two boys came along and when they saw Tom with someone larger than he was they must have figured something was going to…
